steps.what: Show stored results for stability, interoperability, and security.
Verify stability, interoperability, portability, security, or scalability of the architecture.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows test results already stored for the architecture. The run that produced them is not the engineer's time and is not counted. The systems engineer verifies stability, interoperability, portability, security, or scalability. A missing result is not a pass. The list does not verify the architecture.
tasks.previous_blocker: A diagram was treated as proof because the last test result could not be found.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored results can be shown. Verifying what they mean still takes the engineer.
tasks.still_hard: A result for one property does not speak for portability or scalability.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer verifies the architecture. A stored number is not the verification.
tasks.altitude: Verification stays with the engineer. Stored results are visible and are not treated as a pass.

reach.role: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
reach.task: Run a test whose result the engineer will verify.
reach.learn: A stored number is not the verification.

evidence.claim: Showing stored test results is a lookup. The test run that produced them is existing runtime and is not saved labour.
Verifying stability, interoperability, portability, security, or scalability stays with the engineer. A missing result is not a pass.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The architecture id and results already stored against it. A blank result is not filled with a pass. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the stored results before copying them into a note.
unknowns: Whether portability and scalability results sit on the same record as security results.
research_questions: Which result age still counts as evidence for this architecture?

already_counted.description: Verifying the architecture stays with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop results for architectures that have been retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still verifies the architecture property by property. Only showing results already stored is removed. The test run is not counted. A missing result saves nothing and is not a pass.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the software patch record already stored for this fix.
Research, test, and verify proper functioning of software patches and fixes.

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the patch record already stored, including the system it names. A scanner's earlier run is not the engineer's time and is not counted. The systems engineer researches, tests, and verifies that the patch functions. A record with no system name is not tested against a guess.
tasks.previous_blocker: A patch was marked done because the vendor file had arrived, before anyone ran it.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored patch record can be opened. Testing it still happens on the system.
tasks.still_hard: A patch that loads and still breaks a neighbouring function has to be seen by the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer tests the patch and says whether it functions. The record is not the test.
tasks.altitude: Research, testing, and verification stay with the engineer. The stored patch record only names what was already filed.

reach.task: Prepare a fix the engineer will test on the named system.
reach.learn: A patch file arriving is not the test.

evidence.claim: Showing a stored patch record is a lookup of an id and a system name. It does not test the patch.
Researching, testing, and verifying proper functioning stay with the engineer. An earlier scanner run is not this labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.
Fields: The patch id and the system already named on the record. A blank system is not guessed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the patch record on the operations system before running the test the engineer chooses.
unknowns: Whether security patches and functional fixes share one record type.
research_questions: Who verifies a patch when the named system is in another team's care?

already_counted.description: Researching, testing, and verifying the patch stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop patch records for systems that have been retired.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still researches, tests, and verifies the patch on the system the record names. Only showing that stored record is removed. A scanner's earlier run is not counted. A blank system saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the functional specifications already agreed for these servers.
Configure servers to meet the functional specifications.
File the accepted server settings and the specification ids.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the functional specifications already agreed. The systems engineer configures the servers to meet them and accepts the settings just made. The {OPS_SYSTEM} change is the engineer's work. Only that accepted version is filed. A specification field that is blank stops the file, and the engineer configures by hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: Settings were copied from the last server, including a value this specification had dropped.
tasks.enabler_now: Agreed specifications can be shown. Configuring the server still happens on the machine.
tasks.still_hard: Seeing that a live server does not match the specification takes the engineer at the console.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer configures the server and accepts the settings. The file stores that version and does not invent one.
tasks.altitude: Configuration stays at the console with the engineer. Filing happens only after those settings are accepted.

reach.task: Run a server the engineer has configured and accepted.
reach.learn: A specification is not the configuration.

evidence.claim: Showing agreed specifications is a lookup. It does not configure the server.
The engineer still configures the server. Filing stores only the settings version the engineer has accepted.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The server id and the functional specification fields already agreed. A blank field is not given a default. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the specification in the document store before typing the same values into a second note.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the systems engineer.
unknowns: Whether every server in the group uses the same specification record.
research_questions: Who may accept settings when the engineer configures a server owned by another team?

already_counted.description: Configuring the servers and accepting the settings stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop filed settings whose specification has been replaced.

approvals.approved_version: settings version and the specification ids it cites

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still configures the servers to the functional specifications and still accepts the settings. Only showing the agreed specification, and filing the version already accepted, is removed. A blank field saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose a design with the engineers.

steps.what: Show the component list already proposed for this design.
Collaborate with engineers or software developers to select appropriate design solutions.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the component list already proposed. The systems engineer collaborates with engineers or software developers to select a design solution and to check compatibility. The list does not select it. A design with no proposal is discussed from the blank page, not from an invented row.
tasks.previous_blocker: The selection was agreed in a call and never tied to the component list the others had.
tasks.enabler_now: A proposed list can be shown. Selecting the solution still takes the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Compatibility that nobody has written down is settled in the room, not on the list.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer selects the solution with the other engineers. The proposal is not the selection.
tasks.altitude: The collaboration and the selection stay in the conversation. The proposed list is only what was already written.

reach.task: Build the solution the engineers have selected together.
reach.learn: A proposed list is not the selection.

evidence.claim: Showing a proposed component list is a lookup. It does not select a design solution.
Collaboration with engineers or software developers, including the compatibility decision, stays in the conversation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A systems engineer in a mid-size European company. A stored record is not the design, and a draft is not the accepted system.

Fields: The design id and components already proposed for it. The screen does not add a component in order to fill a gap. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the systems engineer finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the proposal in the document store before the meeting, rather than retyping it.
unknowns: Whether developers and other engineers see the same proposal.
research_questions: Who records the selection when the conversation agrees and the note does not?

already_counted.description: The collaboration and the selection stay with the engineer.

incremental.description: Drop proposals for designs that have been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still collaborates with engineers or software developers and still selects the design solution. Only showing a component list that was already proposed is removed. A design with no proposal saves none of that conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The systems engineer still verifies the architecture, still tests the patch, and still configures the server. Stored results and stored specifications can be opened. They do not pass the test.
reach: Information security analysts read findings, and this job learns a stored result is not the verification.
Software developers ship the change, and this job learns the engineer still configures the server to the specification.
skills_to_grow: Verify the architecture from the results, and refuse a result the test did not produce.
Test a patch on the system it names, and do not treat a record as the test.
Configure the server by hand, then file only the settings just accepted.
role.ambitious_version: Verification, patch testing, and server configuration stay with the engineer. Stored results and specifications only show what was already recorded.
